title: Velvety Smoked Middle Eastern Lamb Jordanian Braised
description: Jammy, velvety, monsoon-style braised lamb dish from Jordanian cuisine, featuring the warmth of harissa and the depth of ferment-jang.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, harissa, and ferment-jang to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb back to the pot, along with the lemon juice and stock.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the lamb in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with parsley or cilantro if desired.
